ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into the DOJ Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial ties between the Minnesota Governor, Minneapolis Mayor, and other government officials, to determine if there are any potential conflicts of interest or corruption.
questions: What are the financial ties between the Minnesota Governor and other government officials?
Are there any potential conflicts of interest or corruption?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money is key to uncovering corruption. By analyzing the financial ties between government officials, we may be able to identify potential conflicts of interest or corruption.
